title: TypeRegistry
description: Shape of contracts/registry/types.json. Types are never removed; retire them with status deprecated.

responses.description: Command kinds only (spec p1-01 section 5.1a, moved into the registry by p1-02 when the third command arrived). Every message the server sends in answer to ONE command, in send order: `always` = for every adjudicated command, `accepted` = only when accepted. Broadcasts and asynchronous consequences (WORLD_SNAPSHOT, DEPOSIT_FIELD_STATE, HISTORICAL_EVENT_NOTICE) are not responses. A counter identity derived from this list must FAIL when its inputs are all zero.

data_files.description: Data kinds only, and REQUIRED for them (ADR-0015 section 1, registry_version 5): glob patterns relative to the repository's data/ directory naming every file of this kind. The single source for (1) which schema validates a data file and (2) which files the client copy contains - exactly the files of the kinds whose consumers include client. Every data/**/*.json must match exactly one data kind's globs.
